title: Differential Effects of Eicosapentaenoic Acid (EPA) and Docosahexaenoic Acid (DHA) on Platelet, Endothelial and Vascular Function

sections.abstract: The purpose of this study was to determine whether supplementation with oils enriched with long chain n-3 PUFA, either EPA or DHA, had a differential effect on platelet, endothelial and vascular function.
